Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:10:1.hebrew: לשבועה - שכיון שטוען וגונב מבית האיש, ישבע שנגנבה ויפטר:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:10:1.english: For an oath - For since he claims, "And it was stolen from the man's house," he swears that it was stolen and is exempt.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:10:2.hebrew: או אינו אלא לדין - לפרעון, דשומר חנם שטוען "נגנבה" ישלם, דהאי קרא בשומר חנם כתיב, כדאמרי' בהשואל (ב"מ דף צד:):
Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:10:2.english: Or is it only for judgment - [Meaning] for payment: that an unpaid bailee who claims, "It was stolen," must pay, for this verse is written regarding an unpaid bailee, as we say in [the chapter] HaSho'el (Bava Metzia 94b).

Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:10:3.hebrew: שליחות יד למטה - בשומר שכר, "שבועת ה' תהיה בין שניהם אם לא שלח וגו'":
Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:10:3.english: Laying the hand below - In [the passage of] a paid bailee: "The oath of the Lord shall be between them both, whether he has not laid [his hand,] etc."

Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:10:4.english: Laying the hand above - [This refers to the verse:] "And the homeowner shall approach the judges, whether he has not laid his hand."

Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:12:1.hebrew: למעוטי טענת אבד - אם טען נאבדה הימנו ועדים מעידים שגנבו, פטור מכפל, אפילו נשבע:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:12:1.english: To exclude the claim [that it was] lost - If he claimed [that it] was lost from him, and witnesses testify that he stole it, he is exempt from [paying] double, even if he took an oath.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:15:1.hebrew: משלם תשלומי ארבעה וחמשה - כגנב עצמו, דנפקא ליה מגנב הגנב:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:15:1.english: He pays fourfold or fivefold payment - Like a thief himself, for he derives it from [the repetition of] "thief" [and] "the thief."

Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:1:1.english: Regarding a lost item - [This refers to] one who finds a lost item who claims, "It was stolen from me after I found it."

Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:1:2.english: As it is stated: “For any manner of lost thing,” etc. - And regarding one who makes a claim of theft, we establish this verse later in our sugya.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:2:1.english: We learned elsewhere - In [the chapter entitled] HaGozel Etzim.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:2:2.english: [He] pays the principal - For there is no double [payment] except with a claim of a thief.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:2:3.hebrew: הודה מעצמו משלם קרן וחומש ואשם - דכתיב (ויקרא ה) או מכל אשר ישבע עליו לשקר וגו', וזהו אשם גזילות, ואינו בא אלא על הודאת פיו. דאע"פ דלא כתב בההיא פרשה הודאה, כתב רחמנא באשם גזל הגר בפרשת נשא, והתודו את חטאתם וגו'. וחומש נמי אינו בלא אשם:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:2:3.english: [If] he admitted on his own, he pays the principal, a fifth, and a guilt-offering - As it is written (Leviticus 5): "Or anything about which he swore falsely, etc." — and this is the guilt-offering for robbery, and it is brought only upon his own admission. For even though [Scripture] did not write "admission" in that passage, the Merciful One wrote regarding the guilt-offering for robbing a convert in the portion of Naso: "And they shall confess their sin, etc." And [the additional] fifth is also not [paid] without a guilt-offering.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:4:1.english: A claim of loss - [That] it was lost from him.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:4:2.hebrew: בשבועה - לאחר שנשבע לשקר, כדקתני משביעך אני:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:4:2.english: By an oath - After he swore falsely, as it teaches: "I adjure you."

Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:5:1.hebrew: בטוען טענת גנב - בבעל הבית שטוען טענת גנב בפקדון זה — כדכתיב ״וגונב מבית האיש וגו'״ — הכתוב מדבר, וקאמר דאם ימצא שהוא גנב, שישלם שנים:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:5:1.english: Of one who states the claim of a thief - Of a homeowner who states the claim of a thief regarding this deposit — as it is written: “and it was stolen from the house of the man, etc.” — the verse speaks, and it says that if it is found that he [himself] is the thief, he shall pay double.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:6:1.hebrew: או אינו אלא בגנב עצמו - שבעל הבית אמת טען, ונמצא הגנב שגנבו:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:6:1.english: Or is it [speaking] only about the thief himself - That the homeowner claimed the truth, and the thief who stole it was found.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:6:2.hebrew: כשהוא אומר אם לא ימצא הגנב - ולקמיה מוקמינן לה בטוען טענת גנב שנמצא הוא בעצמו גנב. הוי אומר, דהאי קרא דלעיל נמי כשנמצא בעל הבית שקרן קאמר, ולקמיה פרכינן: תרי קראי למה לי:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:6:2.english: When it says, "If the thief shall not be found" - Later on we establish it [as referring] to one who makes a claim of a thief, where he himself was found [to be] the thief. It follows that this verse above also speaks of when the householder [i.e., the bailee] was found [to be] a liar; and later on we ask: Why do I need two verses?

Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:7:1.english: Of the thief himself - The verse tells [us] that a thief pays double.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:7:2.hebrew: או אינו אלא בטוען טענת גנב קאמר - דאם נמצא הוא גנב, משלם כפל:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:7:2.english: Or does it speak only of one who makes the claim of a thief - That if he is found [to be] a thief, he pays double.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:7:3.hebrew: ה"ג - כשהוא אומר "אם לא ימצא הגנב", הרי טוען טענת גנב אמור, הא מה אני מקיים כו':
Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:7:3.english: This is the reading - "When it says, 'If the thief shall not be found,' [the case of] one who states the claim [that] a thief [stole it] is stated; how do I realize, etc.?"

Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:8:1.hebrew: אם לא ימצא כמו שאמר - שטוען נגנבה, כדכתיב "וגונב מבית האיש":
Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:8:1.english: If it is not found as he said - [I.e.,] that he claims it was stolen, as it is written, "and it is stolen from the man's house."

Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:8:2.hebrew: אלא הוא עצמו גנבו - "ונקרב בעל הבית", כלומר, והוא כבר נשבע בדבר שלא שלח ידו. מה כתיב אחריו? "על כל דבר פשע וגו' ישלם שנים":
Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:8:2.english: But he himself stole it - "Then the owner of the house shall be brought [before the judges]" — that is to say, he has already sworn regarding the matter that he did not lay his hand [on it]. What is written after it? "For every matter of trespass, etc., he shall pay double."

Rashi on Bava Kamma 63b:9:1.english: And from what [do we know] - that this [phrase], "and the master of the house shall be brought near," refers to an oath?

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 63b:13:1.hebrew: מגנב הגנב - דהגנב משמע המיוחד, כמו "העולה" — עולה ראשונה (פסחים דף נח:), "הירך" — המיומנת שבירך (חולין דף צא.):
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 63b:13:1.english: From [the contrast between] gannav [a thief] and hagannav [the thief] - For hagannav implies the specific one [i.e., specifically the claim of theft, excluding loss], just like "ha'olah" [the burnt offering, meaning] the first burnt offering (Pesachim 58b), [and] "hayarekh" [the thigh, meaning] the choicest part of the thigh (Chullin 91a).

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 63b:15:1.hebrew: ואידך הגנב לכדר' חייא בר אבא - אע"ג דהאי דריש לריבוי והאי למיעוט, אין לחוש, דהכל לפי סברת הדרש:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 63b:15:1.english: And the other [mention of] "the thief" [is needed] for [the teaching of] Rabbi Ḥiyya bar Abba - Even though this one expounds [it] as an inclusion and that one [expounds it] as an exclusion, there is no need to be concerned, for everything depends on the reasoning of the exposition.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 63b:2:1.hebrew: והעדים מעידים אותו שאכלו - אכלו נקט לרבותא, אף על פי שאבדו מן העולם — פטור מן הכפל בטענת אבד; וסיפא נקט שנגנבו לרבותא, דאע"פ שהוא בעין — חייב כפל, כיון שטוען טענת גנב:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 63b:2:1.english: And the witnesses testify about him that he consumed it - [The Mishnah] stated "he consumed it" to teach a novelty: even though he destroyed it from the world, he is exempt from double payment with a claim of "it was lost"; and [in] the latter clause it stated "that it was stolen" to teach a novelty: that even though it is still intact, he is liable for double payment, since he makes the claim of a thief.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 63b:5:1.english: You must say [that] the verse speaks of one who states the claim of a thief - For this [verse] comes and teaches about that [verse].
